price_use: stored only; no score, valuation or price-based filter. Extreme price difference checks are a future interface and are not executed.
source_quality: Non-Spanish Chinese-only names remain unchanged and are information-insufficient for this Spanish-only pilot. Brand-only names do not establish product identity.
classification: Confidence applies to the stated granularity. Missing capacity/material/variant alone does not invalidate a clear broad object. Polysemy or unresolved primary domain remains information-insufficient. Brand/series context may suggest a hypothesis but is not a literal product fact.
reviewer_kind: AI; no human confirmation is implied

uncertainty_codes.SOURCE_LANGUAGE_INVALID: Chinese-only text in Spanish title field; no reverse guessing
uncertainty_codes.DOMAIN_AMBIGUOUS: Object named but primary use/domain cannot be established
uncertainty_codes.SUBTYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Subtype/variant absent; broad classification may remain valid
uncertainty_codes.MECHANISM_UNSPECIFIED: Mechanism or assembly details not stated
uncertainty_codes.DOMAIN_INFERRED: Primary domain is a common-use hypothesis rather than literal title text

guardrails_from_pilot: Adornment does not establish a DIY kit
Gift set does not establish bath use from a brand word alone
recambio does not establish fuel refill
apósito does not establish adhesive dressing
efecto infinito does not establish a mirror component
Use neutral data-cable category if charging is not stated
Do not force leisure games into creative craft tags
review: AI statuses are only 待审核 or 信息不足. 已确认 requires explicit supplied human feedback and matching annotation hash.
generation_method: Deterministic, title-only candidate families authored by Codex; no parameter training; no human gold implied
